subject: Approval checklist — emergent pilot dedicated slice (Q4)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+pilot@novacorp.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot ask — dedicated slice + autoscale exception (Nova Health)

Team,

We need a short-term dedicated slice for Nova Health's clinical summarization pilot (starts next week). Summary: they want a 3-week reserved GPU pool (16 vGPUs equivalent), predictable latency under 120ms p50 for inference, and an autoscale override to allow 1.5x burst on peak hours. This is emergent for regulatory demo runs and they cannot tolerate node preemption during scheduled windows.

Please see attached pilot_resource_sheet.xlsx with their traffic forecast and SLA-exception-form.pdf. Key asks:
- Ops: confirm whether a 3-week carved slice is feasible from our dedicated pools (region: us-west).
- Product/Revenue: confirm commercial path (discount/credit) and sign-off for an SLA exception.
- Security: ensure audit logging and KMS key scope are aligned (I will loop SSO/security if needed).

Timeline: they go live test harness on Mon 2026-11-16. We need internal approvals by EOD Fri 2026-11-13 to configure capacity and run preflight.

Other notes:
- If we grant autoscale override, we need a rollback trigger and a throttling envelope to avoid noisy neighbors.
- Attachments include a conservative token/throughput forecast (pilot_resource_sheet.xlsx).

Next steps proposal:
1) Ops feasibility check by EOD 11/10
2) Product approval on commercial terms by 11/11
3) Final sign-off from Ops + Product by 11/13

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Product Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ops+pilot@novacorp.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — dedicated slice + autoscale exception (Nova Health)

Laura / team — quick follow-ups from infra perspective:

1) Pool availability: I can provision a logical carve of the us-west dedicated pool for 3 weeks but need exact vGPU sizing. The worksheet lists "16 vGPUs equivalent" — please confirm whether that's sustained or peak.
2) Autoscale override: we can implement a temporary multiplier (1.5x) but need to know: a) which metric drives scale (RPS, token/sec, queue depth) and b) clear SLOs and TLs for rollback.
3) Isolation: we can pin the slice to a placement group to minimize preemption, but doing so will reduce our flexibility for other enterprise pilots.
4) Telemetry: attach util_forecast.csv with our preliminary utilization run. Ops will need a canary schedule to validate cold-starts and KV cache warmup.

If you can confirm sustained vs peak and the exact week windows (UTC), I can return a short runbook and a conf report by EOD 11/11.

- Dev
Dev Patel
Infrastructure & Serving Reliability

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, ops+pilot@novacorp.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — dedicated slice + autoscale exception (Nova Health)

Thanks Dev — adding a concise decision checklist to keep approvals tight.

Decision checklist (proposal):
- Reservation window: 2026-11-16 00:00 UTC through 2026-12-07 23:59 UTC (3 weeks + buffer)
- Slice size: 16 vGPU-equivalent sustained baseline, allow 1.5x burst for 4 hours/day local peak (specify peak window after we get RPS data).
- Autoscale metric: token/sec with queue depth fallback; ops to provide thresholds and a hard throttle ceiling.
- Placement: pinned placement group during reservation window; ops to document impact and confirm loss of flexibility.
- Rollback triggers: sustained >75% infra contention across colocated slices for 30m OR error rate increase >3% for 15m.
- Observability: enable token-level cost traces, latency percentiles, and alerting to oncall.
- Commercial: standard pilot credit (5% credit). Kimberly please advise if this needs a different discount or exec credit.

Action owners and timing:
- Dev: runbook + canary schedule + thresholds by EOD 11/11
- Kimberly: commercial approval and exec note by EOD 11/11
- Laura: confirm sustained vs peak numbers and attach final forecast (Laura action) by 11/11
- Markus: coordinate final sign-off and schedule config once above are in.

I will not flip the reservation unless all three (product, ops, finance) are aligned.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Product Operations

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+pilot@novacorp.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — dedicated slice + autoscale exception (Nova Health)

Conditionally approved.

Conditions I need captured in the DocuSign and the internal ticket before we enable the carve:
1) Reservation limited to the exact UTC window: 2026-11-16 -> 2026-12-07. No implicit extensions; any extension requires a PO or finance memo.
2) Rollback runbook must be tested in canary with one full cold-start and one high-concurrency sweep by 11/14. Dev to attach canary results to the ticket.
3) Autoscale envelope capped at 1.5x baseline and gated by token/sec thresholds — ops to provide thresholds and implement a hard throttle at 2.0x to prevent runaway.
4) Security: KMS scope and audit logs must be enabled for the slice. Laura, please confirm Nova will accept our standard KMS terms.
5) Commercial: pilot credit is OK (5%) but Finance must sign the execution memo; I will route a DocuSign to Nova and internal finance now.

If all the above are attached to the ticket and DocuSign is returned, mark the approval green and ops can provision on 11/15 to validate.

Kimberly Park
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
